description: 21 existing equipment ids unchanged (status existing) plus proposed additions (status proposed or proposedConditional). equipmentClass feeds the coverage matrix; role says whether an item adds external load (load), only supports (support), is a cardio machine (cardio) or is an implement.

nodes.label: Bench
nodes.note: Flat or adjustable bench. A support item: it adds no external load.

nodes.label: Resistance band
nodes.note: Covers loop bands, tube bands and mini bands.

nodes.label: Weight plate
nodes.note: Also used for weighted bodyweight work, such as plate-loaded planks.

nodes.label: Medicine ball
nodes.note: Covers slam balls and wall balls.

nodes.label: Exercise bike
nodes.note: Covers upright, recumbent and air bikes unless the owner asks for a split.

nodes.label: Landmine attachment
nodes.note: Anchors one end of a barbell. Enables angled presses, rows and rotational work that no existing item represents. Tagged together with barbell or plate, which supply the load. Without it, a user without an anchor still sees these exercises.

nodes.label: Sled
nodes.note: The seed tags the sled push as plate. A sled is a distinct item many gyms lack. Needed for push and drag patterns in conditioning.

nodes.label: Plyo box or step
nodes.note: Needed for box jumps, step-ups and elevated work. The seed uses bench for step-ups; a box is the more accurate requirement.

nodes.label: Suspension trainer
nodes.note: Adjustable straps hung from an anchor (generic name; no brand). Supports inverted rows, push-up variants, fallouts and assisted single-leg work.

nodes.label: Preacher bench
nodes.note: Angled arm pad for preacher curls. The seed tags preacher curl as ezBar and bench, which shows it to users who own a flat bench only.

nodes.label: Back extension bench
nodes.note: Roman chair or 45 degree bench. Required for back extensions and reverse hyperextensions, essential for Lower back coverage.

nodes.label: Ab wheel
nodes.note: The seed rollout lists no equipment, so it appears as bodyweight-only. The wheel is a required item.

nodes.label: Stability ball
nodes.note: Needed for ball curls, rollouts and ball-supported core work.

nodes.label: Foam roller
nodes.note: Only if the owner approves soft tissue release content (pattern softTissueRelease). Otherwise drop both.

notProposed.label: Low parallel bars
notProposed.reason: Push-up and L-sit variations can be tagged without them; add only if the owner wants gymnastic content.

notProposed.label: Glute-ham developer
notProposed.reason: Back extension bench covers the common cases; a separate item adds little.

notProposed.label: Dip belt or weighted vest
notProposed.reason: Weighted pull-ups and dips can be tagged plate or dumbbell; the logging type already records the added load.

notProposed.label: Ski ergometer
notProposed.reason: Cardio machine variety already met by five items. Candidate if the owner wants more conditioning options.

notProposed.label: Branded suspension trainers
notProposed.reason: Brand names are not used; see suspensionTrainer.
